param.name: train_directory
param.label: The directory path containing the training data.
param.help: The directory path containing the training data.

param.name: test_directory
param.label: The directory path containing the testing data.
param.help: The directory path containing the testing data.

param.name: image_filter
param.label: The filter for selecting image files.
param.help: The filter for selecting image files.

param.name: mask_filter
param.label: The filter for selecting mask files.
param.help: The filter for selecting mask files.

param.name: look_one_level_down
param.label: Whether to look for data in subdirectories of train_dir and test_dir.
param.help: Whether to look for data in subdirectories of train_dir and test_dir.

param.name: model_type
param.label: Model type. Full built-in models: cyto="cytoplasm model", nuclei="nucleus model", cyto2="cytoplasm model with additional user images", cyto3="super-generalist model". For other built-in models, see https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/models.html
param.help: Model type. Full built-in models: cyto="cytoplasm model", nuclei="nucleus model", cyto2="cytoplasm model with additional user images", cyto3="super-generalist model". For other built-in models, see https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/models.html

param.name: channels
param.label: Channels to run segementation on. For example: "[0,0]" for grayscale, "[2,3]" for G=cytoplasm and B=nucleus, "[2,1]" for G=cytoplasm and R=nucleus.
param.help: Channels to run segementation on. For example: "[0,0]" for grayscale, "[2,3]" for G=cytoplasm and B=nucleus, "[2,1]" for G=cytoplasm and R=nucleus.

param.name: skip_normalization
param.label: Whether to skip the data normalization.
param.help: Whether to skip the data normalization.

param.name: SDG
param.label: Whether to use SGD as optimization instead of RAdam.
param.help: Whether to use SGD as optimization instead of RAdam.

param.name: n_epochs
param.label: Number of times to go through the whole training set during training.
param.help: Number of times to go through the whole training set during training.

param.name: evaluate
param.label: Whether to evaluate the model after training.
param.help: Whether to evaluate the model after training.
